Tips

  • Point to a phrase if pronunciation is difficult; speak slowly and use a friendly tone.
  • Save your destination’s address in the local script to show a driver or ask for directions.
  • Arabic here is primarily Modern Standard Arabic; local dialects vary. In Hindi, choose सकता or सकती to match the speaker when asking to pay by card.
  • For allergies, carry a clearly translated card naming the specific ingredients and explaining the severity; do not rely on a general phrase alone.
  • Look up local emergency numbers before you travel and keep them accessible offline.
